title: A briefing for the banner workshop
passage:
Tomorrow some visitors will enter by the side door and go upstairs without passing the big board. The room symbols are explained only at the foot of that board. The exhibition stand has hooks but no shelf, and the centre asked us to use its signed proof there. They signed the version inviting visitors in, not the directions-only version.

Yesterday’s banner showed a pale line after we rolled it while the ink was fresh. The same file gave a clean result on smoother cloth, but that print had rested all morning before we rolled it. We need to find out whether waiting helps with the original cloth.

The centre called about the opening: “The opening is in the Oak room now. You can bring your things in earlier, but people will come when we told them.” On the banner with green marks, the line under Oak reads “Do join us upstairs.” We checked the whole edge: plain stitching, no loops. The one on the rack says “Oak, one floor up.” Its loops fit. The sewing bench is free.
passageZh:
明天有些訪客會從側門直接上樓，不會經過大告示板。只有大告示板底部才有房間符號的說明。展覽架有掛鉤但沒有層板，中心要求我們用簽核過的校稿內容。他們簽的是有邀請語的版面，不是只指路的那版。

昨天那幅橫幅在墨還沒乾時捲起來，後來多了一道淺色線。同一檔案印在較平滑的布上沒有那條線，但那塊布放了一整個早上，我們才捲起來。我們要查等一段時間再捲，是否對原本的布料有幫助。

中心打電話來談開場：「現在改在橡樹廳。你們可以早一點把東西搬進來，但來賓還是會照我們原先說的時間到。」有綠色記號的橫幅上，橡樹廳下方寫著「歡迎上樓與我們同聚」。整圈布邊都檢查過了，只有平縫，沒有掛耳。架上那幅寫著「橡樹廳，上一層樓」，掛耳正好掛得上。縫紉台現在有空。
